note: Both sets correctly capture the 40W/9W/7W light-output equivalence, the T24 high-efficacy requirement for Harvest Home fixtures, and the vacancy-sensor dimming-bypass requirement. Set B additionally captures the Title 24 requirement that approved high efficacy luminaires be connected to their own switch in the kitchen, bathroom, closet and laundry rooms, which Set A omits. Set A instead repeats the vacancy-sensor requirement twice in near-identical wording, adding no information. Set B is therefore more complete and free of redundancy.
remarks: Both sets omit the LIGHTING LEVELS table in the page image (3 FC general use/movement with 40W bulb at half power; 5-10 FC simple tasks with 40W bulb; 30 FC large size or high contrast with (4) 40W bulbs; 50 FC small size or visually complex with (6) 40W bulbs, tied to the four illustrated tasks) and the statement that the LED bulb has a higher efficacy rating because it puts out more light per watt. Set A's two vacancy-sensor claims differ only in the length of the quoted requirement value.
